g.text: Test enough things and something will look 'significant'

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #555555

g.text: 20 independent tests where NOTHING is going on, each at α = 0.05

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #222222

g.text: With 20 tests: P(at least one false positive) = 1 − 0.95²⁰ = 0.642, and on average 20 × 0.05 = 1 false positive.

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #555555

g.text: Each test is fine on its own. The problem is reporting whichever one happens to come out small.
